claim: Antral rings isolated from Mfge8-/- mice had increased force of contraction in response to methacholine as compared with wild type controls.

claim: Antral rings isolated from Mfge8-/- mice had increased force of contraction in response to KCl as compared with wild type controls.

claim: The thickness of antral smooth muscle was not different when comparing Mfge8-/- and WT mice.

claim: Enhanced contraction in Mfge8-/- mice was not due to smooth muscle hypertrophy.

claim: Incubation with recombinant Mfge8 rescued enhanced contraction in Mfge8-/- antral rings.
source: Incubation with recombinant Mfge8 (rMfge8), but not a recombinant construct where the integrin-binding RGD sequence was mutated to RGE, rescued enhanced contraction indicating that the effect of Mfge8 on gastric smooth muscle was integrin-dependent (Figure 1A,B).
evidence: Supported by experimental data shown in Figure 1A and B.

claim: A recombinant construct where the integrin-binding RGD sequence was mutated to RGE did not rescue enhanced contraction in Mfge8-/- antral rings.

evidence: Supported by experimental data shown in Figure 1A and B.

claim: The effect of Mfge8 on gastric smooth muscle contraction is integrin-dependent.
source: Incubation with recombinant Mfge8 (rMfge8), but not a recombinant construct where the integrin-binding RGD sequence was mutated to RGE, rescued enhanced contraction indicating that the effect of Mfge8 on gastric smooth muscle was integrin-dependent (Figure 1A,B).
evidence: Inferred from the differential effects of rMfge8 versus RGE mutant construct on contraction.

claim: Induction of Mfge8 expression in the smooth muscle of Mfge8-/-—Tg(Acta2-rtTA, TetO-Mfge8) transgenic mice rescued enhanced contraction.

claim: Transgenic smooth muscle expression of Mfge8 significantly reduced the rate of gastric emptying in Mfge8-/- mice.

claim: Enhanced antral smooth muscle contraction could be the result of an increase in calcium sensitivity due to inactivation of myosin light chain phosphatase.
